acquisition.api_key_storage: DATABENTO_API_KEY in the gitignored .env file; never copy it into an artifact.

normalization.availability_rule: available_at equals OHLCV interval start plus one minute
normalization.duplicate_policy: ZN.v.0 plus open_time must be unique; any duplicate blocks the holdout.
normalization.ordering_policy: Rows must be strictly increasing by open_time.
normalization.roll_crossing_policy: If the current and four-hour reference instrument IDs differ, the feature is UNKNOWN and the candidate produces NO_BIAS.
normalization.underlying_contract_lineage: Seal Databento continuous-to-instrument and instrument-to-raw-symbol point-in-time mappings, every source row identifier, and every observed roll transition.

submission_policy.idempotency: Persist submission intent before the API call; recover an exact matching post-intent job before permitting any new submission.
submission_policy.repeated_download_cost_policy: Use the one batch job and its no-additional-charge download window; never submit a duplicate request.

authorization.scope: Complete V2 Milestone 6 under the existing contract: acquire and seal the missing 2025 ZN source under a $1.25 cap, pass every metadata-only readiness gate, open the holdout once, apply the frozen candidate unchanged, record pass or rejection, and stop.
authorization.verbatim: Continue V2 Milestone 6. Authorize acquisition of the frozen calendar-2025 Databento GLBX.MDP3 ZN.v.0 one-minute request with a maximum charge of $1.25. Re-check the estimate before submission and stop if it exceeds the cap. Acquire, normalize, hash, and seal the source without human inspection of market values or outcomes; complete all metadata-only readiness gates; then open the 2025 holdout once, apply the frozen candidate unchanged, record pass or rejection, and stop.

feature_calculation.current_sample: Latest ZN one-minute bar with available_at no later than the 08:00 Europe/London decision.
feature_calculation.current_staleness_maximum: 8 hours, inherited unchanged from the development feature builder
feature_calculation.reference_sample: Latest ZN one-minute bar with available_at no later than decision_at minus four hours.
feature_calculation.reference_staleness_maximum: 3 days, inherited unchanged from the development feature builder
feature_calculation.roll_check: Current and reference instrument_id must be identical.

contract.milestone_rule: Acquire and seal missing candidate-specific 2025 inputs without examining outcomes, verify hashes and completeness, then open the holdout once. Record a pass or rejection for every frozen candidate and stop.

calendar_halves.assignment: Sort every timestamp-complete London case by decision_at and case_id before removing NO_BIAS cases. Assign the first floor(N/2) cases EARLY and the remainder LATE.

matched_controls.comparison_population: Exactly the same cases on which the candidate produces LONG or SHORT.
matched_controls.selection: The control with the larger mean net return after the same frozen costs.

uncertainty.bootstrap_seed: First eight bytes of SHA-256(M6 manifest hash | candidate code | BOOTSTRAP)
uncertainty.confidence_interval: Type-7 2.5 and 97.5 percent quantiles of bootstrapped mean net return.
uncertainty.sign_flip_alternative: Mean selected return is greater than zero.
uncertainty.sign_flip_seed: First eight bytes of SHA-256(M6 manifest hash | candidate code | SIGN_FLIP)

execution.entry_bar_rule: Open of the exact 08:01 Europe/London one-minute XAUUSD bar.
execution.exit_bar_rule: Close of the exact 11:59-to-12:00 Europe/London one-minute XAUUSD bar.
execution.observed_spread_treatment: Pay half the observed entry spread and half the observed exit spread adversely.

holdout.session_case_population: Calendar-2025 London weekdays with exact complete, non-synthetic, spread-bearing frozen entry and exit XAUUSD bars.
